channel.title: The Rugby Paper - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Rugby Paper (therugbypaper.co.uk)

item.title: Harlequins 19-26 Gloucester: Arthur Clark has a day to remember
item.description: George Skivington’s Gloucester savoured the spring sunshine to stun Harlequins and lift their Premiership morale.

item.title: Stephen Jones to focus on attack at Newcastle Red Bulls
item.description: Stephen Jones believes this year’s Six Nations has shown the game is in fine fettle as he looks to bring the same attacking mindset to Newcastle Red Bulls.

item.title: Jeremy Guscott: Now is the time for England to learn to be streetwise
item.description: It’s been hailed as the best ever Six Nations because of its topsy-turvy nature, unpredictability, and exciting edge-of-the-seat stuff, as well as the tournament in which the most tries have been scored.

item.title: It’s a hard road back to the top of the Prem for Northampton Saints
item.description: Northampton Saints returned to the top of the Prem table with a hard-fought one-point win over Newcastle Red Bulls.

item.title: Former England wing Chris Ashton urges RFU to listen to players on Steve Borthwick decision
item.description: England bosses have been urged to copy the All Blacks lead and give the players influence over the future coaching direction of the team.

item.title: 2026 Super Rugby Americas – Round Five summary: Dogos avenge Peñarol defeat as Selknam bounce back
item.description: In round five of the 2026 Super Rugby Americas, Dogos avenged last season’s defeat in the final with a convincing 32-22 victory over Peñarol in Córdoba.

item.title: Women’s Six Nations 2026: England target eighth straight title
item.description: With the Women’s Six Nations just around the corner, England have begun their preparations by announcing their new leadership team for the tournament.

item.title: The rugby number that says the most about 2026 is 7.4
item.description: That was the average number of tries per match in this year’s men’s Six Nations, after the tournament produced a record 111 tries across 15 games according to a report from WinSportsOnline. For a sport that used to treat 20 points as a solid winning total, that figure says everything about where elite rugby is […]

item.title: Dion Khumalo interview: The Zimbabwe & Cobras star chasing a World Cup dream
item.description: At the time of our interview, Zimbabwe international Dion Khumalo was still able to measure his time as a professional rugby player in days: eight of them to be precise.

item.title: What is the Nations Championship? Format, fixtures and how rugby’s new tournament works
item.description: The Autumn Nations Series is dead. Whether you think that is a positive or not, or even if you didn’t really care much for it, it has gone.
